issue.title: Request: Multiplayer Sync, Chore system (eg. button sync)
issue.description:
We already discussed this in your discord server, just opening it as an issue so you can better keep track.

Currently there seems to be no working way to sync eg. a mod-button click ingame to other players during a game, because it seems to be impossible to execute the code for all players at the exact same game tick.

I assume the best solution would be to use the games own system, which is called "Chore". ChatGPT 5.6 Sol inspected the crusader dll and this is what it found out: https://github.com/Serpens66/Stronghold-Crusader-DE-Mods/blob/main/MPTest/CHORE_SYSTEM_FINDINGS_FOR_SCRIPT_EXTENDER.md  

Would be really a huge thing if this helps you to allow for proper multiplayer syncing :)

technicalNotes.body:
A initial version of the Chore API (+network routing through chores) will be available for version 1.5

Oh and one more thing: AI is not useful for identifying the chore Ids here ^^ You will need to verify these yourself in-game.

> AI is not useful for identifying the chore Ids here ^^ You will need to verify these yourself in-game.  

chatgpt is already using ghidra and such tools. I wont ever be able to do such things manually, but if you tell me for what I should watch out, I can ask the AI to check again more closely or build proper diagnosis tools to confirm the findings ingame.

So my guess would be next time I should:
Let chatgpt add proper logging, start a multiplayer game, do all those actions and let the logs confirm the findings?
Should I do this for the findings above? Or are they mostly fine or which ones are not?
I will close this for now as its now addressed, but feel free to open a RE issue on the chore id thing, mapping this out has still a lot of value.
